title: DTN HBH: ztest matrix for S-flag/expiry parse + DTN routing path
description: Child of b7z9.8.2, after .2.2. tests/routing_dispatch: malformed HBH options (bad TLV length, unknown-type action bits, HBH not first, nonzero reserved in S-flag option), S-flag with valid/zero/garbage expiry, forward path with expiry present (hop-limit interplay - spec says S-F messages carry absolute expiry INSTEAD of relying on hop limit), DTN store decision using wire expiry vs caller field. Land with suite green.
close_reason: DTN HBH admission matrix landed in tests/routing_dispatch (commit this round), suite green (gcc-14, ASan/UBSan, -Werror), 20 cases total in test_dtn_hbh_option_parsing. Coverage per the bead's checklist: malformed HBH options — wrong TLV length (case 4), unknown-type action bits 00/10 (cases 6-7), duplicate option (case 3), HBH not immediately after the IPv6 header (case 15, -EBADMSG per RFC 8200 4.3); S-flag with valid (cases 1/13), zero (cases 9/11), and garbage/half-space (case 14) expiry; forward path with expiry present (case 16: MESH ingress + gradient -> FORWARD/PATH_GRADIENT with forward_hop_limit==7 asserted — store-and-forward applies only to DROP outcomes and the absolute expiry governs storage instead of hop limit); DTN store decision uses the wire expiry exclusively (the caller-supplied dtn_expiry_unix field was REMOVED entirely in b7z9.8.2.2 — no caller field remains to conflict with the wire). Reviews: 3 passes on kimi-k3 — correctness PASS, security PASS (reserved-bits-ignore matches the spec fold's MUST-ignore; forward path cannot be hijacked into DTN store), edge PASS with 3 findings all fixed (comment/payload mismatch, missing forward_hop_limit assertion, per-block isolation). Note: zephyr-side ztest coverage beyond the host suite remains covered by the existing prj.conf build in CI.
